col.title: Title
col.author: Author
col.head: Branch
identity.failed.title: Cannot tell which GitHub repository this is
identity.failed.body: The folder needs a GitHub remote and a linked account in this realm.
form.title: Title
form.base.help: Leave empty for the repository's default branch.
pull.form.help: Opens it from this folder's current branch; the branch is pushed first.
issue.again.title: This may create a second issue
issue.again.body: An issue titled “{{title}}” was already sent from this page. Sending it again may create a second one.
pull.again.title: This may open a second pull request
pull.again.body: A pull request titled “{{title}}” was already sent from this page. Sending it again may open a second one.
issue.heldHere: An issue with this title may already have been created. Check it below before you send it again.
pull.heldHere: A pull request with this title may already have been opened. Check it below before you send it again.
made.noLink: GitHub did not send its link back; it is in the list.
issue.unknown.title: This issue may have been created
pull.unknown.title: This pull request may have been opened
unknown.known: “{{title}}” was sent; no answer said whether it was made.
issue.unknown.check: Check again lists the issues with this title. It never sends it again.
pull.unknown.check: Check again lists the pull requests with this title. It never sends it again.
unknown.stop: Stop tracking lets it go. If it was made, it shows in the list.
candidates.none: Nothing with this title yet. It may still show up; check again in a moment.
dismiss.title: Stop tracking it?
dismiss.body: If it was made, it shows in the list. A new send may make a second one.
checkout.title: Check out pull request #{{number}}?
checkout.body: This folder moves to the pull request's latest commit, on no branch: make a branch before you commit. Uncommitted changes can stop it.
checkout.done: Checked out #{{number}}, detached from any branch
checkout.unknown.title: This checkout may have happened
checkout.unknown.known: Checking out #{{number}} was sent; no answer said whether it happened.
checkout.unknown.check: Check again reads the folder's status. It never sends it again.
merge.title: Merge pull request #{{number}}?
merge.body: Merges it into its base branch on GitHub with this realm's GitHub account. It cannot be undone here. Its branch stays; sync to update this folder.
merge.unknown.title: This merge may have happened
merge.unknown.known: Merging #{{number}} was sent; no answer said whether it happened.
merge.unknown.check: Check again reads GitHub's list of pull requests. It never sends it again.
merge.notYet: GitHub does not show #{{number}} as merged yet.
merge.otherRepo: This folder now reads another repository, so its list can't show whether #{{number}} was merged.
candidates.failed: Cannot read the list right now
